description: Curated corpus of current-revision NIST RMF/ATO publications plus AI governance documents. Source manifest — every row in the published dataset must trace back to exactly one entry here.

exclude: NIST annual reports and workshop proceedings
Pre-2010 legacy publications (exception: FIPS 199/200 and SP 800-18r1, which remain in force)
Draft publications (IPD/FPD) unless explicitly added with status 'draft'

documents.title: Risk Management Framework for Information Systems and Organizations: A System Life Cycle Approach for Security and Privacy
documents.notes: The RMF process document. Chunk by numbered section (Prepare/Categorize/Select/Implement/Assess/Authorize/Monitor task structure). Tasks (e.g., 'Task P-1') are natural chunk boundaries in Chapter 3.

documents.title: Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations
documents.notes: PRIMARY SOURCE for all control chunks. URL verified 200 as of 2026-08-08. Parse catalog.groups[].controls[] recursively (enhancements are nested controls). This OSCAL catalog ALSO embeds SP 800-53A assessment objectives/methods as parts within each control — extract them here rather than from a separate 53A file.

documents.title: Assessing Security and Privacy Controls in Information Systems and Organizations
documents.notes: No separate standalone OSCAL file confirmed in oscal-content repo (probed 2026-08-08, 404). Assessment content is extracted from parts with name 'assessment-objective' and 'assessment-method' inside the SP-800-53r5 catalog. Rows derived from these parts get doc_id 'SP-800-53Ar5' and chunk_type 'assessment_objective' / 'assessment_method'.

documents.title: Control Baselines for Information Systems and Organizations — LOW baseline
documents.notes: URL verified 200 as of 2026-08-08. OSCAL profile (list of control imports), not a catalog. Emit one chunk per baseline: text = human-readable summary sentence + sorted control ID list. chunk_type 'baseline'.

documents.title: Control Baselines for Information Systems and Organizations — MODERATE baseline
documents.notes: URL verified 200 as of 2026-08-08.

documents.title: Control Baselines for Information Systems and Organizations — HIGH baseline
documents.notes: URL verified 200 as of 2026-08-08.

documents.title: Control Baselines for Information Systems and Organizations — PRIVACY baseline
documents.notes: URL verified 200 as of 2026-08-08.

documents.title: Standards for Security Categorization of Federal Information and Information Systems
documents.notes: Short document (~13 pages). Chunk by section. The impact-level definitions table (low/moderate/high x C/I/A) should become a single dedicated chunk.

documents.title: Minimum Security Requirements for Federal Information and Information Systems
documents.notes: Short document. The 17 security-related areas section chunks one area per chunk.

documents.title: Guide for Mapping Types of Information and Information Systems to Security Categories, Volume 1
documents.notes: Legacy URL path pattern (pre-2015 pubs live under /nistpubs/Legacy/SP/). Verify with HEAD request in Stage 1; if 404, resolve from landing_page. NOTE: SP 800-60 Rev 2 was in draft — check landing page for final status at build time; if Rev 2 is final, replace this entry.

documents.title: Guide for Mapping Types of Information and Information Systems to Security Categories, Volume 2: Appendices
documents.notes: Information-type appendix entries (D.x sections) chunk one information type per chunk with its provisional categorization. Same Rev 2 caveat as Volume 1.

documents.title: Guide for Developing Security Plans for Federal Information Systems
documents.notes: SSP structure guidance. NOTE: SP 800-18 Rev 2 has been in development — check landing page at build time; if Rev 2 is final, replace this entry and log the substitution.

documents.title: Guide for Conducting Risk Assessments
documents.notes: Appendix threat/vulnerability tables (D–I) chunk one exemplary table row-group per chunk; main body by section.

documents.title: Managing Information Security Risk: Organization, Mission, and Information System View
documents.notes: Three-tier risk management model. Chunk by section.

documents.title: Information Security Continuous Monitoring (ISCM) for Federal Information Systems and Organizations
documents.notes: ConMon process. Chunk by section.

documents.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
documents.notes: TIER 2 HEADLINE DOCUMENT. GOVERN/MAP/MEASURE/MANAGE functions — chunk one subcategory (e.g., GOVERN 1.1) per chunk, chunk_type 'ai_rmf_subcategory'. Trustworthiness characteristics section chunks one characteristic per chunk.

documents.title: NIST AI RMF Playbook
documents.revision: current web version at build time
documents.notes: Web-native resource, no canonical PDF. OPTIONAL for v1 — include only if scraping is clean; otherwise defer to v1.1 and note the deferral in the data card. If included, record retrieval date in provenance.

documents.title: Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1
documents.notes: Practice table (PO/PS/PW/RV practices) chunks one practice per chunk, chunk_type 'ssdf_practice'. NOTE: SSDF 1.2 development was underway — check landing page at build time.

documents.title: Secure Software Development Practices for Generative AI and Dual-Use Foundation Models: An SSDF Community Profile
documents.notes: The AI-specific SSDF profile — core Authorization Gap material. Same per-practice chunking as SP-800-218.

documents.title: CNSSI No. 1253: Security Categorization and Control Selection for National Security Systems
documents.revision: current at build time (2022 edition or later)
documents.notes: cnss.gov frequently blocks automated fetches. MANUAL STEP: human downloads the PDF and places it at data/raw/manual/CNSSI-1253.pdf. Pipeline treats it as pre-fetched. Record sha256 in provenance like all other documents.

documents.title: DoD Instruction 8510.01: Risk Management Framework for DoD Systems
documents.revision: current at build time (July 2022 edition or later)
documents.notes: esd.whs.mil also unreliable for scripted fetch. MANUAL STEP: human downloads and places at data/raw/manual/DoDI-8510.01.pdf. Confirm it is the current change/version before ingesting.
